mapper.sql: ka.id AS article_id, ka.editor_id, ka.slug, ka.title, ka.title_en, ka.summary, ka.summary_en, ka.body, ka.body_en, ka.cover_image_url, ka.status, ka.published_at, ka.created_at, ka.updated_at, e.display_name AS editor_name, e.display_name_en AS editor_name_en, e.created_at AS editor_created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_articles ka JOIN editors e ON e.id = ka.editor_id WHERE ka.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY ka.published_at DESC, ka.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_articles WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT FROM knowledge_articles ka JOIN editors e ON e.id = ka.editor_id WHERE ka.slug = #{slug} AND ka.status = 'PUBLISHED'

SELECT ar.article_id, ar.exercise_id, ar.display_order, ex.name AS exercise_name, ex.body_part AS exercise_body_part, ex.target AS exercise_target, ex.equipment AS exercise_equipment, ex.gif_url AS exercise_gif_url, ex.image_url AS exercise_image_url, ex.coach_cue AS exercise_coach_cue, ex.coach_cue_en AS exercise_coach_cue_en FROM article_references ar JOIN knowledge_articles ka ON ka.id = ar.article_id JOIN exercises ex ON ex.id = ar.exercise_id AND ex.active = TRUE WHERE ar.article_id = #{articleId}::uuid AND ka.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY ar.display_order, ar.exercise_id

SELECT ka.id AS article_id, ka.slug, ka.title, ka.title_en, ka.summary, ka.summary_en, ka.cover_image_url, ka.published_at FROM article_references ar JOIN knowledge_articles ka ON ka.id = ar.article_id WHERE ar.exercise_id = #{exerciseId} AND ka.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY ka.published_at DESC, ka.id
